with 
"Q1" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."deviceSales"), 
"Q2" ("DATA") as (
  select "DATA"
  from "Q1" q
  where JSON_EXISTS("DATA",'$?(@.region.stringOnly() == $B0)' passing ? as "B0" type(strict))
), 
"Q3" ("DATA") as (
  select "DATA"
  from "Q2" q
  order by JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.units[*].max()') desc nulls last, JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.sku[*].min()') asc nulls first
), 
"Q4" ("DATA") as (
  select "DATA"
  from "Q3" q fetch first 10 rows only
), 
"Q5" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."catalog"), 
"Q6" ("DATA", "SOURCE") as (
  select json_transform(r."DATA",
    assign '$."device"' = json [
      select f."DATA"
      from "Q5" f 
      where 
        json_exists(f."DATA", '$?(@."_id" == $x)' passing
          json_query(r."DATA", '$."sku"' error on error disallow array) as "x" type(strict)
        )
    ]
    type(strict)
  ),r."DATA"
  from "Q4" r
), 
"Q7" ("DATA") as (
  select json_transform(
    "DATA",
    set '$tmp1' = PATH '$."device"."name".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."device"."name".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp3' = PATH '$b1',
    set '$tmp4' = PATH '$tmp2.type()',
    case when '$tmp4 != "array" && $tmp4 != null && $tmp3 == 0'
    then ( set '$tmp' = PATH '$tmp2' )
    else ( set '$tmp' = PATH 'elementAt($tmp2, $tmp3)' ignore on empty ) end,
    set '$tmpP0' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."name"' = PATH '$tmpP0' ignore on empty,
    keep 
      '$."sku"',
      '$."name"',
      '$."units"', remove '$."_id"'
    passing json_scalar(0 as int) as "b1"
  )
  from "Q6" q
)
select "DATA" from "Q7"
